title: adaptor.json
body:
{
  "studioCatalogue": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.studio:catalogue",
  "studioInspectGeometry": true,
  "studioPeekOperations": ["foam"],
  "studioPeek": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.studio:peek_input",
  "studioInspect": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.studio:inspect_input",
  "version": "schemaxis/1",
  "declarations": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.filters:catalogue",
  "runtimeFamily": "5.13.3",
  "executables": [
    "pvbatch"
  ],
  "execution": "serial and MPI pvbatch; native distributed CFD outputs; decomposed-case reading",
  "keywords": [
    "OpenFOAM",
    "CFD",
    "slices",
    "contours",
    "scientific visualisation"
  ],
  "id": "paraview",
  "adaptor": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.job",
  "executionCapabilities": {
    "modes": [
      "serial",
      "mpi"
    ],
    "mpiDriver": "normal pvbatch (one Python driver)",
    "geometry": "native parallel XML writers and distributed exact piece verification",
    "mpiOperations": [
      "calculator",
      "foam",
      "integrate",
      "merge",
      "outline",
      "readParallelPolyData",
      "readParallelUnstructuredGrid",
      "slice",
      "sphere",
      "surface"
    ],
    "measurements": "bounded native integrate reductions",
    "clusterQualification": false
  },
  "consoleCapabilities": {
    "authoredSessions": true,
    "multipleDocuments": true,
    "liveGeometry": true,
    "visualReferences": true,
    "geometryReferences": true,
    "imagePixelReferences": true,
    "imageReferenceRequirement": "a current native PNG preview; no inferred object identity",
    "nativeEditReverseSync": false
  },
  "consoleTemplate": {
    "version": "schemaxis/1",
    "nodes": [],
    "scenes": []
  },
  "nativeExtension": ".pvsm",
  "consoleHooks": {
    "validate": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.console:validate",
    "add": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.console:add",
    "show": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.console:show"
  },
  "liveSaveName": "state.pvsm",
  "cliOptions": [
    {
      "flag": "--paraview-root",
      "dest": "roots",
      "action": "append",
      "help": "ParaView installation root"
    }
  ],
  "locationKind": "roots",
  "default": true,
  "registerFunctions": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.functions:register",
  "coverage": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.catalogue:coverage",
  "threadEnvironment": [
    "VTK_SMP_MAX_THREADS"
  ],
  "routes": {
    "schemaxis/1": {
      "module": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.job",
      "workflow": true,
      "scheduled": false,
      "compose": true,
      "graph": true,
      "timeBatches": true,
      "schemaName": "paraview",
      "acceptedArtifacts": [
        "geometry",
        "gltf"
      ],
      "planIndex": 2,
      "schema": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.schema:document_schema",
      "hooks": {
        "verify": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.integration:verify",
        "verifyAttempt": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.integration:verifyAttempt",
        "verifyLegacy": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.integration:verifyLegacy",
        "reusableInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.integration:reusableInputs",
        "acceptResource": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.integration:acceptResource",
        "capturedInputSchema": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.integration:capturedInputSchema",
        "query": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.integration:query",
        "inspectionSetup": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.integration:inspectionSetup",
        "nativeInspection": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.integration:nativeInspection",
        "validateExecution": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.execution:validate_mpi"
      },
      "schemaOrder": 0
    }
  },
  "sections": {
    "style": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.schema:style_schema",
    "time-selection": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.schema:time_schema"
  },
  "referenceSettings": {
    "ParaView appearance": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.publication:STYLE"
  },
  "runtimeSchema": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.schema:runtime_variants",
  "liveArguments": [
    "--force-offscreen-rendering"
  ],
  "liveExecutable": "bin/pvpython",
  "liveGraph": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.integration:liveGraph",
  "capabilities": "schemaxis.adaptors.paraview.capabilities:catalogue"
}
